blobs.README.md:
# RecDeck

RecDeck is a real-time recommendation engine for small online shops that cannot afford a data team.

Small shops watch shoppers churn when generic bestseller lists bury the products they want.

The ranker blends collaborative filtering with on-device session signals to propose ten items in under 40ms.

Offline evaluation shows recall@10 of 0.31 and precision@10 of 0.22 on the public retail benchmark.

Version 2.1 shipped on 2026-10-30 with an 18 percent lift in click-through over the popularity baseline.

The legacy nightly batch job was retired after the streaming ranker proved stable in 2025.

See docs/roadmap.md for planned work and commit 9f3c1ab for the index migration notes.
blobs.docs/architecture.md:
# Architecture

The serving path fans out to twelve shards that each hold a quantized two-tower model in memory.

P99 latency is 40ms at 800 requests per second on a single commodity box.

The /v1/rank endpoint is deprecated and will be removed in 3.0; clients must migrate to /v2/rank.

Previously the team served a popularity baseline from a nightly cron; the streaming ranker replaced it in 2025.
blobs.docs/roadmap.md:
# Roadmap

The roadmap has three phases: faster indexing, multilingual queries, and merchant analytics.

Phase one will cut indexing lag from 6 hours to 15 minutes with an incremental updater.

It will be great for all users now.
